memoria.title: Memoria
memoria.description: Memoria is a collaboration in progress: users turn their photos into AI-assisted short films. I own the frontend and the integration layer with the services that drive generation, from layout and interactions to wiring the APIs end to end.

artchive.title: Artchive
artchive.description: A personal gallery for art I care about—illustrations and drawings from artists I follow. The focus was a responsive, masonry-style layout that reflows cleanly with different aspect ratios so every piece reads well on the page.

cfdoc.title: cf.doc
cfdoc.description: Final-year capstone: an AI-assisted product for teams navigating internal technical documentation. I shipped the marketing site in Next.js and built the core experience—a side-by-side workspace that compares legacy docs with an AI-enriched version so differences and updates are easy to spot.

pimpim.title: Pimpim's adventure
pimpim.description: A compact platformer starring PimPim, a penguin crossing spring, summer, autumn, and winter to get back home. Built in a one-week school sprint in Unity and C#, it was my first hands-on with the engine and scripting—game feel, level flow, and collisions from scratch.

geo.title: GEO
geo.description: GEO est une web app Next.js conçue pour aider les marques à optimiser leur présence dans les réponses des intelligences artificielles génératives (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.). La plateforme s'articule autour de deux axes : l'analyse de la présence & l'audit SEO/GEO qui permet de générer des recommandations concrètes.

uso.title: USO
uso.description: USO bridges osu! and Spotify so rhythm-game taste can inform playlist building. I joined early on UI, then came back years later to revive the app: a full rewrite with a Vue.js client and a Node.js API, replacing the original React and Symfony stack.
